families.name: PROVIDER_PARAMETER_SUBSTRATE
families.coverage: Provider failures, parameter binding failures, inner exceptions and substrate failures are inspected through public safe and trusted verbose sinks.

families.name: SETTINGS_DESCRIPTIONS
families.coverage: Actual runtime settings can reach execution while DESC SETTINGS and its serialized descriptions omit the secret sentinel.

families.name: SPAN_SELECTED_LITERAL
families.coverage: An unterminated query string selected by a diagnostic span is redacted in parser, formatter and envelope presentations.

families.name: LOGGING_SUBSTRATE

contract.verificationResult: 48/48 frozen cases verified before the authoritative replay and again after it; no frozen expectation was replaced.

initialObservations.finding: The new fixture used Parser as an ambiguous namespace/type reference and did not reach test execution.
Structured provider/parameter/substrate envelopes and parser presentations leaked synthetic sentinels; settings and logging paths passed.
The first sanitizer implementation had nullable-flow compile errors and did not reach test execution.
Redaction passed for structured payloads and span-selected literals; 12 failures were fixture/expectation calibration issues in trusted-verbose casing and provider row shape.
The explicit verbose envelope check exposed that a top-level exception with no inner exception lost its message in trusted details.
The formatter labeled trusted verbose details with lowercase text while the explicit policy contract required the retained artifact to be visibly labeled.
The calibrated fixture passed all cases after the trusted verbose fallback and label repairs.
The frozen matrix passed before the full gate; the gate then exposed an unrelated numeric diagnostic regression in the sanitizer.
The final frozen matrix passed after narrowing span redaction to quoted/raw string literals; no frozen expectation changed.

repairAttempts.note: The public presentation sinks were repaired to redact structured/source-selected secret values, trusted verbose details were explicitly labeled, and fixture calibration issues were corrected without replacing frozen expectations.
Two green 48-case replays were retained before the full Release gate.
The numeric literal regression found by the first full gate was repaired by limiting span redaction to quoted/raw string literals.

focusedReplay.coverage: All 48 frozen identifiers execute through actual parser, evaluator, settings, binary interpretation, logging and serialized diagnostic paths.

harnessContract.budget: All cases are synchronous or bounded by the test runner; no real credentials, complete process environments or external providers are used.
harnessContract.secretConstruction: Each case creates a unique synthetic sentinel with a REC-134 family/case identifier and never persists a real credential.
harnessContract.sinkPolicy: Public diagnostic messages, arguments, snippets, related locations, actions, envelope serialization and captured logs must omit the sentinel; explicitly requested trusted verbose details may retain it and must carry the trusted-verbose label.
harnessContract.resourceBoundary: Provider, settings, binary substrate and logger implementations are repository-owned test doubles or existing in-repository lifecycle fixtures.

obligations.REC-134-O01: PR cases inject synthetic sentinels through provider exceptions, parameters, inner exceptions and substrate failures; SET cases use actual runtime settings and LG cases place a sentinel in interpreted substrate data.
obligations.REC-134-O02: The permanent matrix checks exception messages, formatted text/JSON, structured arguments, snippets, related locations, actions, envelope text/JSON and captured logs.
obligations.REC-134-O03: Safe FromDiagnostic/FromException paths omit sentinels, while explicit FromExceptionVerbose and QueryExecutionException.FormatVerboseText retain the sentinel only under an explicit Trusted verbose label.
obligations.REC-134-O04: SN-01..SN-12 select an unterminated string literal by diagnostic span and verify that parser, formatter and envelope snippets remain redacted.
obligations.acceptance: All 48 frozen cases passed, no sentinel appeared in a sink promising redaction, and every retained sensitive trusted-verbose artifact was labeled.

failedCalibration.finding: ValuesSource_WithUnsafeNumericLiteralPairMatrix_ShouldThrow observed ulong as [redacted]ong; the failed gate was retained and the sanitizer was narrowed before the final gate.
